text:
josh: quick post-deploy note: rolled out release canary-2026-03-21b to canary subset for /v2/embed. automated synth shows checksum drift on responses vs baseline for ~3% of samples. https://telemetry.internal/synth/593220 :thinking:

release-bot: [synth] canary test 21: total=600, checksum-diff=18 (3.0%), p99 latency increased from 240ms -> 310ms. affected hosts: canary-node-7. sample ids attached.

priya: checksum drift could be model tokenization change or truncation. was quantization or tokenizer kernel changed in this release?

deploy-bot: deployment metadata: model-variant=v2-quant-int8, runtime-kernel=mmapped-tokenizer-v3

dan: we have a runbook: drift threshold >2% on canary -> hold global rollout and run targeted sample replay. proposing to reduce canary traffic to 5% (was 15%) until validated.

josh: agreed. reduce traffic and run the replay. priya can you start targeted replay against the exact inputs? i'll add a note to release_notes.

priya: starting replay now: `synthctl replay --ids 1012-1029 --target canary-node-7` -> underway.

deploy-bot: traffic-adjust job 77234: set canary traffic=5% (was 15%) -> success.

release-bot: replay result: 18/18 samples returned, 6 with checksum mismatch. stack hint: tokenizer truncation on sequences >1024 tokens -> different token counts on canary. suspect mmapped-tokenizer-v3 change.

emily: ops: seeing elevated disk read latency on canary-node-7 in hosts panel, might affect mmap. opening INFRA-4932 and tagging infra.

priya: small experiment: re-run single-host fallback to mmapped-tokenizer-v2. command: `deployctl set-host-variant --host canary-node-7 --variant mmapped-tokenizer-v2`

deploy-bot: change queued: host-change job 77235 -> success (22s). canary-node-7 now running mmapped-tokenizer-v2.

release-bot: quick synth (post-fallback): 100 reqs -> checksum-diff 0 (0%), p99=260ms. looks promising.

dan: decision: keep canary pinned at 5% and roll kernel fallback to the rest of canary gradually unless infra uncovers a real disk/mmap regression. create a hotfix if fallback fails.

josh: noted. adding to release_notes: "Canary kernel fallback applied: mmapped-tokenizer-v2 restored on canary nodes due to checksum drift when using v3; canary traffic reduced to 5% while we validate. Infra ticket INFRA-4932 opened."

emily: INFRA-4932 created: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-4932 assigned to infra-oncall.

priya: monitoring for 45m. if no further drift, we'll resume baseline rollout and increase to 25% in 2h. if drift returns, escalate to hotfix window at 04:00 UTC.

josh: thanks folks. pinning this summary in release notes and closing chat after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
